summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Orla Mining Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting its first quarter 2026 financial results. The press release discusses operational performance—gold production, revenue, costs, and guidance—and provides project updates on South Railroad, Camino Rojo, and Musselwhite. It also announces a routine quarterly dividend of US$0.015 per share. There is no transaction, no acquisition or divestiture, no activist campaign, no strategic review, no tender offer, no going-private, no spin-off, no restructuring, or any other special-situation event. The filing is a routine earnings report with standard operational updates. It does not trigger any special-situations category.
